title.b: I would be the unknown evangelist

meta.author:
詞：新店⾏道會、邊雲波〈 獻給無名的傳道者〉
曲：新店⾏道會

lines.a: 沒有人留心 曠野如何變樹林
lines.b: No one noticed how the wasteland become woodland

lines.a: 沒有人曉得 樹枝如何結花果
lines.b: No one knew just how branches brought forth fruit

lines.a: 沒有人明白 沙漠為何盛開玫瑰
lines.b: No one understood why roses could bloom in the desert

lines.a: 沒有人知道 荒地為何流出江河
lines.b: Or why rivers and streams flowed from barren ground

lines.a: 在那被人遺忘的地方 卻有佳美腳蹤
lines.b: In the long forgotten places there remain beautiful footsteps

lines.a: 是因無名傳道者走過留下
lines.b: Traces of the unknown evangelists who left behind

lines.a: 我願是 無聲無息的磐石
lines.b: I would be the silent hidden rock

lines.a: 我願是 攻打前鋒的士兵
lines.b: I would be the vanguard strike force

lines.a: 我願是 教會隱藏的基礎
lines.b: I would be the hidden foundation of the church

lines.a: 我願是 沒有功章的英雄
lines.b: I would be the undecorated heroes

lines.a: 多少不知名靈魂 得到了生命
lines.b: Countless nameless souls have found life

lines.a: 這個時代的復興 是我們禱告的累積
lines.b: The revival of this age is the accumulation of our prayers

lines.a: 我們仍然呼求祢的名
lines.b: We still call upon Your name

lines.a: 我們仍然信靠祢的名
lines.b: We still trust in Your name

lines.a: 我們仍然高舉祢的名
lines.b: We still lift high Your name

lines.a: 永遠堅定
lines.b: Forever steadfast

lines.a: 不害怕 十架道路 越走越難
lines.b: I will not fear, though the cross grows harder each day

lines.a: 跟隨神 不放棄的心志 越難越堅
lines.b: Following God, with a heart that will not turn away

lines.a: 仍然忍耐到底 要把世路走完
lines.b: Still I endure, till the race of this life is done

lines.a: 直到和救主面對面相見 榮耀那天
lines.b: Till face to face with my Savior, glory has come

lines.a: 沒有人回想 福音如何傳來這地
lines.b: No one remember how the gospel first came to this land

lines.a: 沒有人追憶 神僕們得救的經歷
lines.b: No one recalls the saving grace that God's servants had

lines.a: 做神的工作 會參雜著血淚苦心
lines.b: The ministry of God is suffused with tears and toil

lines.a: 一代代聖徒 都出於那無聲獻祭
lines.b: Generation to generation - a silent sacrifice remains

lines.a: 我願是 無聲無息的磐石
lines.b: I would be the silent hidden rock

lines.a: 我願是 攻打前鋒的士兵
lines.b: I would be the vanguard strike force

lines.a: 我願是 教會隱藏的基礎
lines.b: I would be the hidden foundation of the church

lines.a: 我願是 沒有功章的英雄
lines.b: I would be the undecorated heroes

lines.a: 我們仍然呼求祢的名
lines.b: We still call upon Your name

lines.a: 我們仍然信靠祢的名
lines.b: We still trust in Your name

lines.a: 我們仍然高舉祢的名
lines.b: We still lift high Your name

lines.a: 永遠堅定
lines.b: Forever steadfast
